no_adcom_quote.quote: Your applications for Diacomit (stiripentol) capsules and powder for oral suspension were not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile of Diacomit is acceptable for the proposed indication.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for NDA207223 (Diacomit/stiripentol). The approval letter explicitly states the applications were not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile of Diacomit is acceptable for the proposed indication. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
